meta.description: Topic approval gate via Telegram. Uses worker approval tokens. Wait resumes on webhook.

parameters.content:
## Telegram setup (n8n UI)

1. Add Telegram node → send `telegram_text` to your chat
2. Inline buttons: APPROVE / REJECT / NEW_IDEAS
3. Wait node (On Webhook Call) — resume with decision
4. HTTP → `/api/approvals/topic/decide`

Do not embed bot token in this JSON export.
